activity.notes: Stephen I (Hungarian: I. István), the first king of the Christian Kingdom of Hungary, was crowned around the turn of 1000/1001 and ruled until his death in 1038. ATLAS records the royal reign as 1000-1038, with the start boundary explicitly approximate because modern scholarship commonly gives the coronation as 1000/1001. His preceding rule as prince from 997 is a distinct office and is not merged into this kingship Activity.

sources.title: Hungarian kings of the house of Árpád — At the Gate of Christendom
sources.citation_text: Cambridge's Árpád-dynasty chronology lists István I as 997-1038 and explicitly notes that he was crowned king in 1000/1001.

sources.title: Collection B — Hungarian National Museum
sources.citation_text: The Hungarian National Museum identifies the denarius of King Saint Stephen I and gives his royal reign as 1000-1038, linking his coronation and coinage to the Christian Kingdom of Hungary.
